notes: Choose an existing animation, active bone in the selected skin, valid duration and a NEW animation name. Endpoints inside the animation must already satisfy the selected limits.

Explicit bake mode captures the ordered rig/constraints before repairing the NEW animation, disabling constraints only in that new animation. Original animations, definitions and controls remain unchanged.
physics=true explicitly captures reset physics using the configured FPS. Physics and world-pose budgets reject oversized work; reduce FPS or animation duration when required.
Double-FPS samples plus exact boundaries check local limits and original unselected/outside world matrices against bakeTolerance. Failures do not grant publication or visual acceptance.
Before/after diagnostics and shared-camera media remain separate from user visual review. Promote only the explicitly selected exact candidate.
